svg.aria-label: Before and after. Before, the error-reports collection holds one row per fingerprint with only the newest five occurrences, and only the intake's internal entry reads it. After, the same collection also holds one history row per day, appended on every intake and every status change, and one read-only tool, listErrorReports, reads the reports and the history for error-reporter and the Shift Coordinator.
svg.text: FIX-2793 · WHAT CHANGES
Where the error history lives, and who reads it
BEFORE
One row per fingerprint, newest 5 occurrences
error-reports/* holds fp-, storm-, cap, held- and task- rows.
Occurrence 6 and on are only a count. Status shows only as it is
now. Only the intake's internal reports entry reads the rows;
error-reporter's turn has reportProblem, and the Shift
Coordinator reads nothing.
AFTER
Same collection, plus one history row per day
log-YYYY-MM-DD rows get one entry per occurrence the intake
takes and per status change (previewing, filed with Linear ID
and URL, dismissed, closed). listErrorReports, read-only, reads
reports and history for error-reporter and the Shift
Coordinator.
ADDS
One row kind, one read-only tool, two WORKER.md lines. No second store.
STAYS
Report rows, dedupe, cap, storm, preview in Inbox, filing, and the browser can still not read the collection.
